summary: 2026-07-29 19:42 PDT — The deep-audit plan/execution boundary and roadmap status are honest, but the story does not meet its accuracy and linter ACs. Canonical docs retain stale inventories, and the linter has reproducible false-green paths despite passing shellcheck and shfmt.

findings.title: Stale four-skill inventories remain
findings.claim: AC2 explicitly requires the stale “three loop skills plus /dev-audit” framing to be removed, but that exact inventory remains here. ARCHITECTURE lines 211–212 and README line 127 also omit /deep-audit from the stand-down list, contradicting the new recon sections that correctly say both recon skills stand down. The canonical docs therefore remain internally inconsistent and omit a shipped skill in multiple feature inventories.
findings.suggestion: Update README’s stand-down section and ARCHITECTURE §§3.5–3.6 to include /deep-audit and consistently describe three loop skills plus two recon skills.

findings.title: Per-skill checks fail open
findings.claim: The here-string can fail before the while loop runs, but the script lacks errexit or an explicit redirection-status check. In this review environment Bash reported “cannot create temp file for here document,” skipped every README/ARCHITECTURE skill assertion, then printed passed=2 failed=0 and exited successfully. An unwritable or exhausted temporary directory can therefore make the linter silently enforce none of its core invariant.
findings.suggestion: Feed the loop without a here-string, such as process substitution, and explicitly fail if enumeration cannot run; alternatively make the script fail closed on shell/redirection errors.

findings.title: Command regex accepts file paths
findings.claim: The trailing delimiter excludes only alphanumerics and hyphens, so /frame/SKILL.md and /deep-audit.md both match. A skill mentioned only as a path or filename can therefore satisfy the claimed “documented as a /command” invariant, contrary to the comment and AP-2 decision.
findings.suggestion: Require the repository’s actual Markdown command form, such as a literal backtick-wrapped `/name` token, or implement suffix handling that rejects path separators and filename extensions.

findings.title: CI suite count is inaccurate
findings.claim: The branch wires tests/docs_test.sh into a gate that now runs five suite scripts, but README still says “three test suites”; ARCHITECTURE line 190 repeats the same stale count. This violates the story’s cross-document accuracy requirement.
findings.suggestion: Replace the brittle numeric count in both documents with an accurate description, preferably “the configured workflow test suites,” or update it to five.
